testo:
■ Whenever your opponent puts a creature into the battle zone from anywhere other than their hand, you may put the top 5 cards of your opponent's deck into their graveyard.
■ Whenever a card would leave your deck by the effect of one of your opponent's spells or creature's ability, it stays instead.
testo_jp:
■ 相手のクリーチャーが手札以外のどこからでもバトルゾーンに出た時、自分は、相手の山札の上から５枚を墓地に置いてもよい。
■ 相手の呪文の効果またはクリーチャーの能力によって、カードが自分の山札から離れる時、離れるかわりにとどまる。
